title: finding(docs): a fourth stated docs-page population on ci-cd-pipeline.md — `556-page docs build`, hyphenated so objectui#7448's noun pattern misses it, and copied a second time into the gate's own header
body:
Found while implementing objectui#8629, which removed three stated populations from `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`. ⛔ Not fixed there: it is a fourth sentence the card did not name, and it is mirrored outside `content/docs/**`, so it needs its own decision.

## The instance

The Docs Route Eager Closure section argues why the gate is structural rather than byte-level, and does it by pricing the alternative as a docs build of a stated number of pages ("a 556-page docs build in CI"). The same figure is written a second time, in the header of `scripts/check-docs-route-eager-closure.mjs`, in the same sentence shape.

Nothing derives either copy. The corpus that route is built from is **184** git-tracked `.md`/`.mdx` files under the directory `apps/site/source.config.ts` declares (measured on the branch for objectui#8629), and the gate's own `gauge:` line reports **144** compiled MDX modules among its route roots. Neither reading is near 556, and neither can move the sentence.

## ⭐ Why the pin family did not see it, and why that half matters more

objectui#7448's family matches a numeral followed by whitespace and a document noun. This figure is **hyphenated and singular** — `556-page docs build` — so the noun pattern misses it, in both copies, the same way a per-line unit missed two of objectui#8629's three (that unit lesson is recorded on objectui#8629 and objectui#8606).

⇒ the family currently has a **shape** gap on top of the unit gap it just closed. Widening the noun pattern to accept a hyphenated attributive is a change to a pattern shared by all carriers of the family, which is why objectui#8629 recorded the gap in its pin's own comment instead of widening it unilaterally.

## What this card has to decide

1. Whether the sentence keeps a number at all. It is an *argument about cost*, not a claim about today's tree — it may be honest to state it against a named commit, the way the four correct sentences on that page do, rather than to derive it.
2. Whether the two copies stay two. The doc half and the gate-header half say the same thing twice, which is the shape objectui#8606 dissolved on the workflow side by deleting the count and pointing at the derivation.
3. Whether objectui#7448's noun pattern gains the hyphenated attributive form. That one touches every carrier, so it is a family-wide change, not a per-page fix.

## Scope note

⛔ `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` currently has two other cards queued behind objectui#8629 (objectui#8726 and objectui#8420). Whoever takes this one merges `main` first; the page is hot.

Filed by the objectui#8629 developer seat, unassigned, for triage.
